task_description: Phase 6 implementation: Achievement/Badge system for horizontal progression, Cooking mini-game with recipe system and Chef Bao NPC, and Seasonal festivals/events using the existing clock/season infrastructure. All features add new ECS components/systems, i18n keys across 12 locales, and comprehensive tests.

verification.summary: All 770 tests pass (457 game-engine + 313 web). Format, lint, and build all green. v2 review fixes applied: totalCoinsEarned now uses delta detection on wallet.coins (captures all income sources), totalFishCaught wired via FishCaughtListener from FishingSystem to AchievementSystem.recordFishCaught(), totalQuestsCompleted polled from QuestComponent.entries each frame.
